name: Cerebras Inference trial credit
amount: $5 of credit, expiring 30 days after it's granted
summary: One-time trial credit for Cerebras's very fast inference, usable on every model in its shared catalogue. Trial rate limits are low (e.g. 5 requests/minute, 1M tokens/day on gpt-oss-120b). Often still described online as a recurring free tier, which it no longer is.
